topic: real wealth is what you don't see
lines: #You can see the car. The watch. The *designer* bag.
You can't see the debt that isn't *there.*
#Some of the wealthiest people you'll ever meet drive an old *car.*
Live in a normal house. Wear normal *clothes.*
#And some of the people who look *richest*...
Every dollar spent showing off is a dollar that can't *grow.*
The bag goes out of style. The *savings* don't.
The car loses value. What you build in *yourself* doesn't.
It's being able to say no to a job you *hate.*
It's sleeping well when the bills *arrive.*
It's knowing your family is *covered* if something goes wrong.
end: Save this. Real wealth is quiet.

post.title: Real Wealth Is Invisible
post.caption: Looking rich and being rich are opposites. Get quietly rich. 🤫
post.first_comment: Would you rather look rich or be rich? 👇
